steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Welcome back, Iwona.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: You look like murder.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: No shit I do.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Didn't get to mangle every last inch of those knight sons of bitches' armor... grr.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: It wasn't your fault.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: He didn't tell any of us how bad it'd gotten.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: With an infection like that, he should've stepped aside months ago.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: He should've found his way out of Kazimierz, followed his dreams. Should've gotten to sort out his final days.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Olmer Ingra... the Kawalerielki knight noble to a T. Despotic, ignorant, no regard for human life.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: I should've broken all four of his limbs in the arena when I had the chance...

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: It's not your fault either, Ashlock.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Dammit. And I was right there!

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Did he... say anything... in his final moments?

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: You wouldn't want to know.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: On the contrary, I wish I could.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Fine.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: It's not rare at all... for Infected to pass on with regrets.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: We'll remember his anger.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Sona?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: His name was Jamie. He was a competition knight, and then an Infected after an accident.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: He went through a divorce. He had a sweet little girl. He must've been underreporting his condition so he could keep on competing... He needed the money.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: But in order to underreport his condition, he'd have to bribe the Knights Association.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: I found the letters between him and the Association staff in his room. It was a bottomless pit.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: He was the optimistic type. So optimistic to the point he couldn't even tell the sort of burden he was shouldering.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: He caught Oripathy, he parted ways with his wife and daughter, but he kept on helping people.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Do you still remember? He was always up at the crack of dawn just to look after the kids.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: He shouldn't have died in this indignity. It goes against the founding intent of our Knightclub, but...

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: But I can't get over it...

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: It was the end of the end, and someone so filled with passion for life, in his final moments, let loose such haunting, unforgettable hate.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: If this is how things are—

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: ...Sona.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: You've had too much on your mind lately. Careful you don't get so fixated.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: ...I'm gonna leave all this knotty thinking work to you guys.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: I'm gonna get stronger. Strong enough to crush those sanctimonious bastards between my fingers. Strong enough to clear the way all by myself.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: The Blood Knight's a fine example. Since at least Kazimierz recognizes a 'knight' these days, that's the path we should be take.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Don't overthink stuff, Sona. It'll only slow you down.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: ...Sona!

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Alright, alright, I get it. We need to step it up and check with Szewczyk—

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: The wind... there was a change in the wind's stirring. Even if just for a moment...

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Someone's watching this place, and not just that...

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: The Armorless?

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: They know how to mask their breathing. But if they're after us, they should've attacked by now.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: —Come out.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: This is Infected territory. No uninfected would ever just wander in here.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: If you don't—

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: Alright, alright. Keep the noise down, sheesh.

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: Never dreamed I'd see Infected knights around. I haven't been anywhere near Kawalerielki in over ten years, but the knight bosses and businessfolk are all out of their minds.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Who are you?

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: Don't get me wrong, I was in the neighborhood looking for someone. But, well, this might just be meant to be...

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: ...I'm thinking we share some of the same interests, my Infected friends. Like... the Armorless Union.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Sorry, but we've been through some very unfortunate things today. If you really want to chat, try some other day.

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: Oh? That's some rotten luck indeed. My condolences.

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: Then I can only go somewhere else and try my luck there. Not every day I visit the Grand Knight Territory, after all.

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: I'll leave you all be, then... but we might see each other again very soon.
I found the knight who took Szewczyk. The runaway Fartooth Knight.
She's mingling with Pinus Sylvestris, of course. Infected knights have a way of sticking together—
—What's that noise on your end? Are you at a bar again?
Fine, looking into the Nightzmora's background, that's a decent excuse. When's the order being issued regarding the Infected?
...What?
Didn't the Szewczyk case end up like this precisely because they were 'still officially meeting to decide?' They sent a whole drone to bomb him—what point is there in still...

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Well, jeez... tell me all you like, but the Major's running right now no matter what you say. They can't be all that cavalier about deciding.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Yep, mm-hm, I'm not slacking one bit, trust me.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: It's true—hey, boss, you got any fries?

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: One moment.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Cool. Hey? Monique, you still there?

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: ...Classic, she hung up.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Here's your fries, sir.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Oh, nice. Appreciate it.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Mm...! Who's the genius who came up with slicing a tater this thin and frying it too? The world wouldn't be so beautiful without you, whoever you are.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Come to think of it, that real standout Maria Nearl, she graces this place pretty often with Whislash Knight, if I'm remembering right?

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: If you came looking for an autograph, you'd better be extra lucky.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: After all, this bar's for nothing but old retired fogies.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Who's that there? Couldn't be an Armorless Union spy?

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: God knows, he hasn't tried anything. Not like we can frisk him, either... hey, is he sizing you up?

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Hrrm... just ignore him.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: I've been getting the twitchiest eyes since last night... Can't shake the feeling something big's going to happen.

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: Finally hit the right age for insomnia?

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Eh? I'm fit as a fiddle! What do you know! It was the twitches back then that told me we had incoming artillery fire—

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: What the hell big's going to happen to you? Are you going to squeeze olive oil out of your toothpaste tomorrow morning?

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: —Hmm.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Marcin. I can sense their aura now... it's someone major.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: I've never had a premonition strange as this before... here's hoping they won't make trouble.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: (Here they come. Nice and fast, too... mmm, I'll just let it happen.)
–– (Ancient language) The young hunter sets out on his Khaganquest ♪
–– (Ancient language) From dreams he goes, towards the shores of gold ♪

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: (This language...!)

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: What's going on? Kids these days wander into bars singing their own songs? What's the point of the jukebox, then?

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: The Nearls' light can't really have stuck to my lonely little bar, can it? But I've never met a knight like you in my time... V? What's wrong?

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: I... I don't know, it's just suddenly my heart feels a little...
(Ancient language) ...Batbayar, brethren, the last descendant.
(Ancient language) Why be in a place like this?

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: You...! You know that name?
The silent knight looks around. Where his gaze touches, the light hides.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Answer me. How do you know that name?

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: Hey, V, this a friend of yours?

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Would you like a drink? Sir? If you've got no business, I have to tell you we don't welcome armed knights too warmly here.
(Ancient language) How sorry this is.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Hold on, don't just up and go—

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Kowal, Maria will be borrowing your workshop a while longer—

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: —Er.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Zo—Zofia, slow down... agh!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Why did you—stop, what's going on?
...You are...

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: ...Nightmare Knight?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: What's the rising star of the year doing here? Are you trying to sneak out intel on Maria and Margaret?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: If so—

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: How clamorous.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Watch out!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Wh... What are you trying to do here!?

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: Pegasus... a weak race. Only those pegasi with blood of flowing gold are worthy rivals.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: But once the pegasi abdicated, this so-called 'Land of the Knights'...

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: Its grasslands turned feeble. You cannot be blind to it, can you, Kuranta?

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: In present Kazimierz, you people, all are called knights?

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: And in those... pompous arenas, you test your martial skills?

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: After your little act just now, I'm not finding the will to talk to you all nice and happy.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Hold it... boy, I still have things to ask you. The last thing I want right now is to put a bolt through your head.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: Not bad... you have the will to fight still.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: What about you, then?

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Uh, me? Like, me? I'm just a fan of knights, just in the neighborhood. No need to waste the effort pretending I exist, I'll be fine.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: I can't do a thing anyway, not a single thing, mm-hm.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: (Tremoriron Marcin, proficient with warhammers. Vogelweide, campaign knight marksman. Whislash Knight, not much of a threat since she was injured... Maria, no need to monitor for the time being.)

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: (But none of that really matters... mm-hm... the Nightzmora came looking for Vogelweide after all...)

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: (Alright... now... what to do. Will the Radiant Knight come?)

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: This place is not worth even a quick visit. Keeping company with you people makes one uneasy to stand still.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Alright, boy, who d'you think you're looking down on?

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: (Ancient language) Batbayar, in the past you campaigned on the battlesands, fought with your own two hands, yet could only barely manage to protect your homeland.

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: (What's he saying?!)

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: War... you're a campaign knight? You recognize me?

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: (Ancient language) No, I'm no 'knight.' Nothing so ridiculous. Simply put, war is the only path in which you never shamed your ancestry, descendant.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: (Ancient language) Though you stand here... in this city of steel and concrete, neon flitting through the rain, descendant, I hope you can still remember the breathing of the grasslands, and the vow the Khagan swore.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Khagan? What...?

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: You're going on about some stodgy old tale?

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: (Ancient language) I intended... before setting out once again, to seek my surviving brethren in this so-called land of the knights. It seems, now, I was simply deluded.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: (Ancient language) No matter.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: (Ancient language) Kazimierz's frailty spits on Khagan's accomplishments. Someone must set such conduct straight.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Stop right there! You still haven't answered me!

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: Hm... Though now you've lost all that made you, you're still at least half a brother... I should answer your question.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: It was an old veteran who told me your name, and he, he was ruined in his age, not even able to run.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: I seek every one of my brethren in Kazimierz. No matter how weak their relation, I seek them and nothing more.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Come again? Brethren? In Kazimierz, is that right?

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: It's no longer your concern, Kazimierzian.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Hold it.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Nightmare Knight... I've heard plenty about the badly-behaved newcomer you were.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: You should've known we wouldn't let you go so easily after you kindly brandished your sword at us.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: How about you take off your helmet and we have a nice chat?

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: 'Nightmare'...? Ah, the title those city slaves plastered on me without permission?

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: Ridiculous... that knights are so obsessed with these names now...

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: It is only their inherent beliefs, and desire to grasp destiny, that urge knights to embark on their journey.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: The Knights Association won't be happy to look the other way with you picking arguments like this. Do you want to be stripped of Major qualifications?

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: If... only vapid knights like you remain in Kazimierz... then I really am wasting my energy. What harm would losing worthless qualifications be?

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: However, this pegasus by your side... seems to very much resemble someone I wanted to find...

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: What?! You mean... my sister?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: —What do you want with the Radiant Knight?

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: What I want...? Look at all the Grand Knights Kazimierz elevates as champions—if there remains any opponent worth conquering in this present country, I fear it may be among them.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: Of course... it may also happen that they're all disappointments.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: You've gone mad, haven't you. You came here just for a fight?

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: (Ancient language) Mad?

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: (Ancient language) Yes... the people who choose to live in the Kazimierz of now often tell me so...

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: (Ancient language) ...which is why we are no longer brethren.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: I said stop! Are you just leaving like nothing even happened?

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: Given this endeavor is fruitless, I have no need to stay...

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: Goodbye, descendant.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Grr...

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: What in the world was wrong with that man, all high and mighty...

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: I can only hope Margaret doesn't meet him in the arena.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Seems he came for a quick look at you, then? Is he from your home place?

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: He's... a Nightzmora?

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: What? There's still Nightzmora alive today?

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: Here I thought they were all in legends, or they were holing up in Sargon or some sort.

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: So what? What's someone from your grandpa's grandpa's side doing finding you?

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: ...He's calling to us.

steps.name: Left-hand Knight
steps.text: ...Tch.

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Oh! Oh! This is history, being made before our eyes!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Can 'Left-hand' Tytus Topola lead the Blade Helmet Knightclub in a breakthrough here, and return to his spot as one of the top sixteen tyrants?!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: This battle reeks of revenge! All of you watching! I hope your blood's on fire! He's fallen short of the Final 16 over and over, but today, will 'Left-hand' Tytus Topola have what it takes to overcome himself?!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: It all comes down to one thing—his opponent!!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: In the long and storied history that is the Topola family's knightly record, only one time! Only one opponent! Has brought such colossal shame!

steps.name: Left-hand Knight
steps.text: Damn you...

steps.name: Left-hand Knight
steps.text: What have you been doing, all these years?!

steps.name: Left-hand Knight
steps.text: (Why... to hell with this...)

steps.name: Left-hand Knight
steps.text: (How do I fight now? Do I make some room? No, she... hff... why is she using a swordspear, of all the things...)

steps.name: Left-hand Knight
steps.text: (Most important...)

steps.name: Left-hand Knight
steps.text: (...is that she... somehow has me... pressured?)
Tytus Topola shuts his eyes.
He considers this a scene of impassioned vengeance, a long-brewing opportunity to prove his worth.
But all his resentment, visions and fervor, have here and now vanished like smoke.
He cannot help but concede, this is no standoff.
Only a challenge.
A challenge, striding for the pinnacle.

steps.name: Left-hand Knight
steps.text: (Since I became the Blade Helmet Knightclub's frontman, when was the last time I felt like this?)
A challenge, an advance, climbing to an ever higher domain.

steps.name: Left-hand Knight
steps.text: Hah... heheh, it makes me want to laugh...

steps.name: Left-hand Knight
steps.text: The Radiant Knight, are you truly the same woman?

steps.name: Left-hand Knight
steps.text: To force me back to this degree... and yet you don't feel a hair of pride, not a drop of excitement? Where did the mettlesome you of yesteryear go?

steps.name: Left-hand Knight
steps.text: Look at you now, so serene one could gag—

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: I don't mean to look down on you, Tytus. I never have.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: However, you've already lost your way.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: In the hunt that was the melee, at least, you were the last one standing. You forced your way free on nothing but a single arm like you had originally done, imbued purely with the desire to win.

steps.name: Left-hand Knight
steps.text: Hahah... you've even learned to preach, now? Could it be? Your days of banishment have made you the lecturesome kind?

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: ...Tytus.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Why would you let those logos bind you?

steps.name: Left-hand Knight
steps.text: —Listen, Radiant Knight!

steps.name: Left-hand Knight
steps.text: Weren't you always prattling on and on about those rancid traditions... urging us to—use the most traditional methods to decide victory?

steps.name: Left-hand Knight
steps.text: A charge, a skirmish, an all-expending effort.

steps.name: Left-hand Knight
steps.text: I will trample... all that you are!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Left-hand Knight is composed and steady! Does he plan to decide this with one final plunge?!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: And the Radiant Knight is—now the Radiant Knight's slowly raising that bizarre weapon—

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Who will be stand victorious after this final clash? What are you waiting for, audience?! You have the power to show your support for these knights, so do it—!

steps.name: A Passing Tourist A
steps.text: Is that the Candle Knight, Droste? What's she here for?

steps.name: A Passing Tourist B
steps.text: Maybe she's waiting for someone... quit staring, hurry up and sneak a picture... who knows if we can hit on some major scandal...

steps.name: An Arena Worker
steps.text: The Candle Knight! Madam, I'm very sorry to leave you unattended. Are you looking for someone?

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: It's alright, it was brash to come without notifying anyone. I just wanted to take a look at how the Radiant Knight cuts her figure.

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: After all, I imagine it's almost over.

steps.name: An Arena Worker
steps.text: Yes, Left-hand Knight Sir Tytus Topola lost ten minutes ago to the Radiant Knight. Sir Tytus has incredible strength, but he can't be too hopeful after falling into the losers' bracket in the first round.

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: Indeed.

steps.name: An Arena Worker
steps.text: Did you... really come just to meet the Radiant Knight?

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: I want to see. See just how different she is now, compared to what I've heard in the rumors of knights.

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: All the crowd's gone rushing over.

steps.name: An Arena Worker
steps.text: R—Right. Actually, ever since the Radiant Knight officially returned to competition, she's barely cooperated with our standard service activities.

steps.name: An Arena Worker
steps.text: She constantly leaves arenas without saying a word, and scheduled interviews and all sorts of PR items get rejected. It really makes your head spin.

steps.name: An Arena Worker
steps.text: Though actually, I think there's even more reporters mobbing the Radiant Knight than usual today. I wonder what that's about?

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Ah... sorry, can you just let me through...

steps.name: An Excited Reporter
steps.text: Miss Margaret, what are your views on the Infected knight who passed away on the field? Will this affect you in any way?

steps.name: A Pushy Reporter
steps.text: Madam Radiant Knight, do you have anything to say about the Knights Association's recent decision? Can infection actually contribute to an unfair playing field?

steps.name: An Excited Reporter
steps.text: Ah, Miss Margaret, is it possible to reveal anything about the state of your infection? Can you confirm if the Knights Association's measures to keep it confidential are a disservice to the spectators and the other knights?

steps.name: An Excited Reporter
steps.text: There are reports of you getting close to a few Sarkaz women! Who are they to you? Give an explanation, please!

steps.name: A Pushy Reporter
steps.text: Madam Radiant Knight! Please respond—do you intend to become the spiritual leader of the Infected knights?

steps.name: A Pushy Reporter
steps.text: —Will you be the second coming of the Blood Knight—

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: I won't be answering your questions.

steps.name: An Excited Reporter
steps.text: Can we take that as an admission? Then what relation do you and those Sarkaz—

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: Well met, Madam Nearl.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: And you are...?

steps.name: An Excited Reporter
steps.text: The Candle Knight, Droste! The Candle Knight was waiting outside the arena for the Radiant Knight!

steps.name: A Pushy Reporter
steps.text: Give the schedule printout to me... that's right, they'll meet each other on the field... hey, get a snap of this, quickly! Snap it!

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: May we... walk and talk?

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: (I presume you don't want the media haranguing you any longer, either?)

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Ah... yes.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Right then. Let's go somewhere else.

steps.name: An Arena Worker
steps.text: I'm sorry, please keep your distance—the press conference will be held at a later time, please can everyone just be patient for now! Patience, please!

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Now then...

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: You've been through a lot, legend of Kazimierz.

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: Your banishment has conversely cast much of a veil of mystery on 'The Radiant Knight'... the holy, haloed knight, the awe-inspiring golden pegasus, the hero who returned like a shooting star...

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: I saw as I came close today, you were still very young, and disconcerted by such a sudden situation... Margaret Nearl, this is the real, living person.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Come what may, I thank you for helping me just now.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: I assume you're a knight too, though I don't believe I know you?

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: It's been a while since someone asked me who I was. More than who I am, they care who they wish I was.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Er, I'm very sorry. I haven't been back in Kazimierz for too long...

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: ...Heheh.

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: Are you concerned that because you don't recognize me... I may fly into a rage?

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: I can tell, you're quite unlike anyone else.

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: My, now, thank you for the praise.

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: I'm very pleased myself to get to know such a Radiant Knight. My name is Viviana Droste.

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: Or perhaps, you may also call me The Candle Knight.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: The Candle Knight... no, Miss Droste, thank you once again for your help today. Were you seeking me for any reason?

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: Before long, we'll face each other on the field.

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: You are an Infected, and one who was once met with banishment. Make no mistake, I have no habit of connecting with my opponents before a match.

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: I come from Leithanien; I am an expatriate, living in this bustling city under an identity I could never imagine.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Kazimierz's recognition is already yours, Miss Droste.

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: I hear the Radiant Knight never approved of the current system of knighthood, and so, you were consequently banished. Do you still feel the same way?

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: The knights of Kazimierz are forgetting their obligation as we speak.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Have you ever been to the most destitute corners of Kazimierz? Conflict, starvation, infection... the common person suffers enormously, while the knights hide in their cities, making great shows of peace and prosperity.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: The spirit of knighthood is almost completely lost. It's a legacy for capital to wantonly toy with.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: How is it not a form of disgrace?

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: ...I see.

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: It seems—it is you who stands as a true knight.

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: But you are... still no more than a knight.

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: How about your sister? She's been active on the field for the past while.

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: Has she renounced... the path of knighthood?

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Miss Droste... and Miss Margaret, good evening.

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: Good evening, Mr. McKee.

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: Thank you for tending to the commotion just now.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: ...*Sigh*. So you do have that much self-awareness...

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: With two Grand Knights such as yourselves, the masses could make each and every move a hot topic. Put the two of you together in front of the media...

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: But never mind all that, there's always some way to sort it out. Miss Droste, you should be preparing for your meeting with the Leithanian noble tomorrow.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: If you would, I'd appreciate you avoid exacerbating uncertain factors for the next while.

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: Such as, meeting with an Infected knight?

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: It seems the noble in question has come for your sake, Miss Droste. You have a celebrity status to the Leithanians too.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Mieszko Industries is very willing to assist them with construction planning in Leithanien, but the one putting the final seal on this trade contract is you, Miss Droste.

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: Of course... it is my obligation.

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: It seems I must apologize, Madam Radiant Knight, that I'm unable to continue my chat with you tonight.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: It's alright. You gave me a pleasant surprise... that Kazimierz still has knights such as yourself.

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: The next we meet will be on the field.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: I look forward to the day.

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: A final word of advice... Madam Radiant Knight.

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: The storm is nearing.

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: The trails will be especially radiant in the starry sky, these coming days of ours.
